北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京霾天气温 16℃，体感偏凉，外出注意防护，多喝水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Hazy and cool 16℃ in Beijing. Stay protected outdoors and hydrate!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阵雨，体感 15℃，湿度 96%。出门带伞，小心湿滑！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Showers and 15℃, 96% humidity in Ningbo. Take an umbrella, watch for dampness!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海中雨体感 18℃，记得带伞，小心路滑，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain and 18℃ in Shanghai. Take an umbrella, watch for slippery roads!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴热 30℃，北风 5级。防晒补水，注意大风哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot 30℃ with strong wind in Guangzhou. Stay cool, hydrate, mind the wind!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗 30℃，体感 33℃。阳光正好，注意防晒和补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot 30℃, feels like 33℃ in Shenzhen. Enjoy the sun, protect from heat!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 15℃，湿度 90%。出门添衣，别受凉啦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and 15℃, 90% humidity in Hangzhou. Dress warmly to avoid catching cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 20℃ 左右，天气舒适，心情也要美美的哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and comfy 20℃ in Nanjing. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 19℃，湿度 78%，微风拂面，适宜出行散步。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and 19℃ in Chengdu, light breeze. Perfect for a gentle stroll.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天 20℃，湿度 72%。天气舒适，别忘了保持好心情。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and comfortable 20℃ in Wuhan. Keep a cheerful mood!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗体感 16℃，阳光正好，适合出门走走，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and 16℃ in Xi'an. Lovely for a walk, remember to stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天 20℃，体感 19℃。天气略有凉意，记得添衣哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and 19℃ in Chongqing. A bit cool, remember to add a layer!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，风力 5级，体感 12℃。添衣防风，别着凉啦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with strong wind, feels like 12℃ in Harbin. Dress warm against the wind!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，风力 5级，体感 13℃。注意防风保暖，多喝热水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with strong wind, feels like 13℃ in Shenyang. Stay warm and hydrated!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗 25℃，阳光明媚，注意防晒补水，享受好天气。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and 25℃ in Kunming. Enjoy the sunshine, mind sun protection and hydration!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云 31℃，风力 6级。天热风大，注意防晒和防风！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and 31℃ with strong wind (force 6) in Xiamen. Protect from sun and wind!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 17℃，风力 4级。天气宜人，出门注意防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and pleasant 17℃ with moderate wind in Qingdao. Mind the wind outdoors.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 13℃，风力 4级。外出添衣，注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and 13℃ with moderate wind in Dalian. Dress warm and mind the wind!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦晴热 31℃，风力 7级。天气炎热大风，务必注意防晒安全！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot 31℃ with very strong wind (force 7) in Zhangpu. Stay safe from sun and wind!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，湿度 90%，体感 19℃。注意防潮，带件薄外套哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and humid 19℃ in Cixi. Mind the dampness, bring a light jacket.
